title: Whether a tree is a machine install is read inline at each reader, manifest_field kind compared with install, one spelled differently; one predicate answers it
body:
Whether a tree is a machine install is asked inline wherever it matters: each reader runs `manifest_field <root> kind` and compares the answer with `install`. One question spelled in many places is how the spellings drift. One of them already differs. Raised as R7 by dc's critic-shell review of 0251, and declined there as wider than that issue. Measured by vc on main at 49278183 on 2026-10-27.

## Measured

- `[ "$(manifest_field <root> kind 2>/dev/null || true)" = install ]`, or its negation, appears at:
  - bin/devbin:202;
  - lib/cmd/shell-init:215;
  - lib/install:77 and :1000;
  - lib/resolve:99;
  - lib/helpers:3411 (devbin_tree), :3438 (devbin_install_old), :3971 and :4189.
- lib/helpers:4120 reads the kind into a variable and compares it there.
- bin/devbin:145 spells it without `2>/dev/null || true`.
- dc's 0251 bank adds another, in lib/cmd/devbin's show_overview.

## Fix

One predicate in lib/helpers, `is_install_tree <root>`: rc 0 when the manifest at <root> says `kind: install`, rc 1 otherwise, a manifest that cannot be read included. Every reader above asks it, devbin_tree among them, and none reads the kind itself to answer that question.

## Done when

1. No reader outside `is_install_tree` compares a manifest's kind with `install`. A tree-scan arm holds that.
2. The landing suite passes under BSD and GNU (the files holding the readers' arms, with the tree scans and help), and CI is green on the pushed head.

It builds after 0251 lands, so 0251's site is moved too.

## Resolution

0262 is fixed by b0ea3fe0 (tree 7268956b), the third of the line's four commits on 6bb2e15c (0251 cdd2f186, then 0253 8e39dc89, then 0262, then 0266 f172b06f). 6bb2e15c is the PRE: the version chain's tip 1792ae25 with main's 0257 (landed on main as f3cbab33) picked, and it is not landed again. The chain under the line has since landed on main (0259 1229314e, 0260 e6fd4a98, 0263 4a9bd32e, 0264 ce5d39e1, 0265 7c814e93), and main's code outside intent/ equals 6bb2e15c. l7 was built because 0253 was amended (0253's Resolution says why). b0ea3fe0 has the same stable git patch-id as its predecessor in l6, a9846881. It builds after 0251, so 0251's overview reader is moved too. The bundle's tip is the tip the landing run tested, f172b06f.

### What changed, against "Done when"

1. **[x] No reader outside `is_install_tree` compares a manifest's kind with `install`. A tree-scan arm holds that.**
   - lib/helpers: `is_install_tree <root>`, beside manifest_field, is `[ "$(manifest_field "$1" kind 2>/dev/null || true)" = install ]`: rc 0 when the manifest at <root> records `kind: install`, rc 1 otherwise, a manifest that is not there or cannot be read included.
   - Every reader asks it: bin/devbin's wrong-tree guard and its install-tree branch; lib/resolve; lib/install's two; lib/cmd/shell-init's _shell_init_prefix; lib/helpers' readers, devbin_tree and devbin_install_old among them, with the negation that was `!=` now `! is_install_tree ... && [...]`; 0251's install overview in lib/cmd/devbin; and fleet's census (install_kind) and sweep (sweep_source) in bin/.devbin/cmd/fleet, which the issue's Measured list missed.
   - The dispatcher's guard, which read the kind without `2>/dev/null || true`, now asks the same predicate, so no reader spells the read's failure its own way.
   - At the tip, `git grep -nE "manifest_field[[:space:]].*kind" -- bin lib` finds one line, is_install_tree's body (lib/helpers:3781).
   - The arm, contract.bats' "a tree's kind is read as an install in one place, is_install_tree, and by no other reader (0262)", scans lib/ and bin/ for a read of the manifest's kind, the field quoted or not and a comment excluded. It requires the hits to be exactly the line after `is_install_tree() {`, read from lib/helpers itself, so it holds no count. It fails if lib/helpers has no such line, and separates a grep error from no match.
2. **[x] The landing suite passes under BSD and GNU (the files holding the readers' arms, with the tree scans and help).** The light ran contract, dispatch, helpers, machinepointer, shellinit, localinstall, use and doctor whole under BSD and GNU, with help and the tree scans, every test passing. It also ran fleet.bats and install.bats whole under BSD and GNU at f172b06f, which hold the arms of fleet's census and sweep and of lib/install's readers: fleet 155 of 155 ok under each, and install 103 of 103 ok under each, one of them its case-folding skip. CI on the pushed head is vc's landing to read.
   - The first light of fleet.bats and install.bats, at l6's tip 992cd9d8 (slot 01M61PN0QRXSJJBRN04NW02S61, END 17:03:16Z on 2026-10-28, released, log ~/Devel/scratch/devbin-dc/l6f/light-01M61PN0QRXSJJBRN04NW02S61.log), was red on one install.bats test under BSD and GNU. That red was on 0253's line (bin/.devbin/lib/helpers:65, its floor search's Linuxbrew default), not on anything of 0262's; 0253's Resolution records it and the amend.

### The critic review

- The critic-shell subagent reviewed the bank, 0cba56d7..77d767f9: 1 critical, 3 warning, 5 recommendations. The settlement (8f3684b5) took them in one amend with vc's word on the arm's controls. The line carries it as the one commit b0ea3fe0.
  - **CRITICAL (Highlander: fleet's two readers):** bin/.devbin/cmd/fleet's install_kind and sweep_source still compared the kind inline. Both now ask is_install_tree; fleet already sources lib/helpers.
  - **WARNING (red-control: the scan could not see bin/.devbin/cmd/):** taken. The arm scans all of bin/.
  - **WARNING (red-control: shapes the pattern missed):** taken in part. The pattern allows a quoted field and any whitespace after `manifest_field`. Not taken: a field held in a variable, and a read of the `kind:` header by awk, grep or sed, which would need a second pattern. The critic measured no such reader in the tree.
  - **WARNING (red-control: the arm checked a path prefix, not the line):** taken. The expected hit is derived from the line after is_install_tree's definition, and the hits must equal it.
  - **Recommendations taken:** a comment quoting the read is excluded, as the sibling arms exclude one; a grep error is told from no match (`|| [ $? -eq 1 ]`); the hand-written `-eq 1` is gone with the derived line.
  - **Recommendations filed:** an install tree whose manifest cannot be read is told to run `devbin install` (older than 0262, measured by the critic at the dispatcher's guard), filed as 0282; runtime_version reading the manifest's devbin_version with its own awk, filed as 0283.
  - **The planted controls** the bank's arm carried, three `grep -q -E "$pat"` here-strings, were removed at vc's word (hv's 2026-10-08 ban on controls that check checks). The arm keeps its floor, which must find is_install_tree's own read, and its one-reader invariant.
- **Behaviour at each reader** (the critic, measured at the guard, read at the others): status and stdout are the same as before at every site. The one difference is at the dispatcher's guard, where the old form let awk's raw "can't open file" line through to stderr for a manifest that cannot be read; that line no longer prints, in line with issue 0215.
- **The critic leg** ran `intent critic shell` on the line's changed shell (12 files, bin/devbin and bin/.devbin/cmd/fleet among them) and exited 0. It asked 2 of the 6 shell rules.

### Which arms are red on main, and which hold unchanged behaviour

- **Red on 6bb2e15c:** the contract.bats arm. The base has no is_install_tree, so the arm stops at its floor, "lib/helpers has no is_install_tree() { line -- the scan would allow nothing", before it scans.
- **Hold unchanged behaviour:** the existing arms of every converted reader. 0262 changes no expected text. Those in dispatch, helpers, machinepointer, shellinit, localinstall, use, doctor, fleet and install ran whole at the tip (Done when 2).

### Evidence

- **Red on 6bb2e15c:** red clone l7/red-6bb2e15c at 08435b43 (6bb2e15c plus the line's seven test files from the tip: contract, dispatch, formula, helpers, localinstall, machinepointer, shellinit; neutral no longer differs from the base), BSD. contract.bats' 0262 arm ran 0 ok and 1 not ok, logged at 17:06:37Z by the driver's date -u.
- **Arm greens** at f172b06f: contract BSD at 17:07:09Z and GNU at 17:07:51Z, 1 of 1 each.
- **The light** at f172b06f, in slot 01M61QKQNRN8Y972DZCVTG0MNY. START was 17:06:29Z and the driver exited 0 at 17:51:42Z on 2026-10-28, both by date -u. The slot ran the line's arms first, then one light. It did not run the version chain's arms again, since the chain has landed on main.
  - Run whole under BSD and GNU, every test passing:
    - version (73), releasecut (140) and doctor (65);
    - helpers (115), dispatch (121), machinepointer (35), formula (34), use (30), shellinit (38), localinstall (62), contract (43), fleet (155) and install (103, its one case-folding skip);
    - help (58).
  - documentation (28) under BSD, and under GNU with the tree scans.
  - The tree scans ran under GNU, and every test passed: neutral (10), documentation (28), readonlygit (11), harness (34, its two expected skips), vendoredmd (3), workroom (5) and installhints (1). helpers and contract ran whole under both.
  - The critic leg exited 0, as above.
  - The log is ~/Devel/scratch/devbin-dc/r23c/run-l7-01M61QKQNRN8Y972DZCVTG0MNY.log, and the TAP is in l7/runs/ (arms/ and light/).
- **The bundle:** see SHA256SUMS in this directory (`line.bundle`, ref l7 at f172b06f, on 1792ae25).
- **The landing:** vc landed it at 4a3f5175 with land-stack.sh (LAND_BASE_OFF_MAIN=1), commit by commit, as run. Its paths equal the tested tip's. The BSD and GNU full suites run once before the cut, and CI reads the pushed head.

- **CI:** run 40752126678 on the pushed head a6a875b3, which carries the landing, read green by vc.
